boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Mary's University of Minnesota
boards.description: A current, under-21-safe set of campus and Winona destinations with publicly posted evening availability.

cards.title: The Cardinal Club
cards.subtitle: Michael H. Toner Student Center, Saint Mary's University of Minnesota
cards.notes: Use the first-floor Toner Student Center counter for made-to-order sandwiches and other food items before its 10 p.m. weekday close.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus made-to-order option with weekday evening availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's identifies the Cardinal Club as a first-floor Toner Student Center food option and lists Monday–Friday hours of 10 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Food Services | Saint Mary's University of Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–10 p.m.; closed Saturday–Sunday.

cards.title: Mango's Mexican & American Grill
cards.subtitle: 408 Highway 14 West, Winona
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, carry-out, or patio seating; the restaurant posts 10:30 p.m. closing on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.short_summary: A family-operated Winona restaurant with later Friday and Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: Mango's official site lists dine-in and carry-out at 408 Highway 14 West and restaurant hours until 10:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant closes at 10:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday; 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday; 9 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Culver's of Winona
cards.subtitle: 1441 Service Drive, Winona
cards.notes: Use the lobby, curbside, or drive-thru service before the posted 10 p.m. close, and check the location page for daily updates.
cards.short_summary: A Service Drive restaurant with daily service through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver's lists its Winona restaurant at 1441 Service Drive and posts lobby, curbside, and drive-thru hours of 10:30 a.m.–10 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Culver's of Winona, MN - Service Dr
cards.access_notes: Lobby, curbside, and drive-thru are posted daily from 10:30 a.m. to 10 p.m.

cards.title: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery
cards.subtitle: 956 1/2 Mankato Avenue, Winona
cards.notes: Head to the Mankato Avenue dining room or arrange pickup, curbside, or delivery before the restaurant's posted 10 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A full-service restaurant and bakery open nightly to 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins lists its Winona location at 956 1/2 Mankato Avenue, with restaurant hours of 6 a.m.–10 p.m. daily and pickup, curbside, and delivery services.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are posted as 6 a.m.–10 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Pizza Hut
cards.subtitle: 1630 West Service Drive, Winona
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order at the Service Drive location; Tuesday through Sunday availability is posted until 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A carryout and delivery pizza stop with 11 p.m. service most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut's official location page lists carryout and delivery at 1630 West Service Drive, with both available until 11 p.m. Tuesday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut Takeout in Winona, MN
cards.access_notes: Carryout and delivery are posted until 11 p.m. Tuesday–Sunday; Monday closes at 8 p.m.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 1201 Gilmore Avenue, Winona
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery through the location's online ordering link when you need a later evening food option on Gilmore Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A Gilmore Avenue pizza location with publicly listed late closing availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Winona location page identifies the store at 1201 Gilmore Avenue, offers carryout and delivery ordering, and currently lists it open until 1 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 1201 Gilmore Ave, Winona
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently displays “Open Today Until 1:00 AM”; confirm the live ordering page before departing.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 1455 Gilmore Avenue, Winona
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the later window; the official location page posts daily service through 1 a.m. while dine-in closes earlier.
cards.short_summary: A daily 1 a.m. drive-thru option on Gilmore Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official Winona page lists the restaurant at 1455 Gilmore Avenue and drive-thru hours of 7 a.m.–1 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Winona, MN - 1455 Gilmore Ave
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is posted daily until 1 a.m.; dine-in hours end earlier, at 10 p.m. on the listed schedule.

cards.title: Subway
cards.subtitle: 1488 Gilmore Avenue, Winona
cards.notes: Use the Gilmore Avenue location for sandwiches, wraps, salads, or cookies before its published 10 p.m. close every day.
cards.short_summary: A daily 10 p.m. sandwich option on Gilmore Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway's official Winona location listing identifies the 1488 Gilmore Avenue restaurant and posts 9 a.m.–10 p.m. hours every day.
cards.access_notes: The 1488 Gilmore Avenue location is posted as open daily from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.

cards.title: Hy-Vee
cards.subtitle: 1475 West Service Drive, Winona
cards.notes: Stop by the grocery store for produce, bakery items, and everyday essentials before the posted 11 p.m. daily store close.
cards.short_summary: A Service Drive grocery stop open every day until 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Hy-Vee's official Winona store page lists the store at 1475 West Service Drive and says it is open daily from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Store hours are posted as 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; individual departments have separate hours.

cards.title: Walmart Supercenter
cards.subtitle: 955 Frontenac Drive, Winona
cards.notes: Use the Winona Supercenter for groceries and essentials before its posted 11 p.m. closing time; department schedules can differ.
cards.short_summary: A general-merchandise and grocery stop with daily 11 p.m. store hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Walmart's official page lists the Winona Supercenter at 955 Frontenac Drive and posts store hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Store hours are posted as 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; verify individual service departments separately.
